findings.title: camelize('', uppercase_first_letter=False) raises IndexError
findings.property: camelize does not crash on any str; the empty string maps to the empty string for both values of uppercase_first_letter
findings.actual: IndexError: string index out of range (string[0] at inflection/__init__.py:171)
findings.evidence: Signature is camelize(string: str, ...) with no documented restriction on empty strings; camelize('') returns '' for the default flag, so the False branch is inconsistent.

review.title: camelize('', uppercase_first_letter=False) raises IndexError on empty string
review.reason: The signature accepts any `str` and the docstring excludes no inputs. `camelize('')` correctly returns `''`, but the `False` branch evaluates `string[0]` unguarded (inflection/__init__.py:171) and raises IndexError. Empty strings are a normal edge case, the two branches should agree, and the fix is trivial, e.g. `string[:1].lower() + camelize(string)[1:]`.

findings.reproSource:
from inflection import camelize


def test_repro_camelize_empty():
    assert camelize("", True) == ""
    assert camelize("", False) == ""
